findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_prd" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit the completed software PRD and app development estimate for email delivery and portal project creation. Call it only after user stories, requirements, te…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_estimate_status, submit_prd · Private data: start_session, submit_prd · Public sink: send_turn, send_action, get_estimate_status, submit_prd · Destructive: start_session, send_turn, send_action, submit_prd.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_estimate_status, submit_prd · Private data: start_session, submit_prd · Public sink: send_turn, send_action, get_estimate_status, submit_prd · Destructive: start_session, send_turn, send_action, submit_prd

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
